info.name: NovaTrust Responsible AI Gateway (S011-S016)
info.description:
Every endpoint of the NovaTrust lab, in lab-guide order, with example bodies and tests.

1. Start the server: uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
2. Import this collection and the environment file; select the environment.
3. Run folder by folder, or the whole collection with the Collection Runner.

Tests check structure and the deterministic guardrail behaviour, so they pass with Gemini, other providers, or mock mode. Requests that depend on model behaviour log results to the Postman console instead of asserting them.

item.description: Health check and the guardrail audit log.
